readerInvitation.closingInvitation: Begin with the compressed opening to see the diagnosis and constructive direction together. Then follow the community governance chapters before reading the personal AI proposal. The historical chapters explain how useful arrangements accumulated powers their users struggle to contest. The technical ending makes the alternative specific enough to question and improve. This book suits readers designing communities, digital services, and the rules of online participation. Its useful depth lies in connecting institutional rights with services people actually need. Read it to distinguish changing your provider from gaining a voice in your digital world.
